        print(f"Columns: {list(exps[i].columns)}")

        if 'ReactorPressure' in exps[i].columns:
            print(f"ReactorPressure: mean={exps[i]['ReactorPressure'].mean():.2f}, sd={exps[i]['ReactorPressure'].std():.2f}")
        for col in exps[i].columns:
            if col not in ['unit_id', 'ConversionEfficiency', 'ReactorPressure']:
                print(f"{col}: {exps[i][col].describe()}")
    except:
        print(f"Experiment {i}: could not load")

# Check correlations in experiments with ConversionEfficiency
print("\n=== CORRELATION ANALYSIS ===")
for i in [1,2,4,6,8]:
    if i in exps and 'ConversionEfficiency' in exps[i].columns and len(exps[i].columns) > 2:
        corr = exps[i].corr(numeric_only=True)
        print(f"\nExperiment {i} correlations with ConversionEfficiency:")
        for col in corr.columns:
            if col != 'ConversionEfficiency':
                print(f"  {col}: r={corr.loc[col, 'ConversionEfficiency']:.3f}")

# Test if ParticleSizeCat intervention had an effect (experiment 6)
print("\n=== PARTICLE SIZE CAT ANALYSIS (exp 6) ===")
if 6 in exps and 'do_set_ParticleSizeCat' in exps[6].columns:
    psc = exps[6]['do_set_ParticleSizeCat']
    ce = exps[6]['ConversionEfficiency']

    print(f"\nBaseline CE mean: {baseline_ce.mean():.2f}")
    print(f"Exp 6 CE mean: {ce.mean():.2f}")
    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(ce, baseline_ce)
    print(f"t-test vs baseline: t={t_stat:.3f}, p={p_val:.2e}")
